Title: Kalendarz - event icons: tooltip layout (two columns)
Preconditions:
User is logged in
Calendar page (BOK or Warsztat) is loaded
Task exists with at least 2 events assigned (e.g. Części niepotwierdzone + another event)

Step: Hover over the task to display the tooltip.

Verify bottom section of the tooltip:
- section for event icons is present at the very bottom
- icons displayed in two columns
- each entry shows: icon + event name
Verify if event names are translated according to current UI language.
Expected result: Event names are displayed in correct language.

Step:
Verify icon style:
- colour and size same as other icons currently used in tooltip

Verify text style:
- colour and size same as other text currently used in tooltip
End of test.

Title: Kalendarz - event icons: overflow indicator (+N) when icons do not fit
Preconditions:
User is logged in
Calendar page (BOK or Warsztat) is loaded
Task exists with more events assigned than can fit in the task's icon row width

Step: Verify if visible icons are left-aligned and ordered by priority.
Expected result: Icons displayed correctly, ordered by priority.

Step:
Verify overflow indicator at the end (right side) of visible icons:
- format: +N (N = number of hidden icons)
- displayed as white number only, no border/background
Verify that N correctly reflects the number of icons NOT shown.
Resize the task/column (if possible) or reduce number of events so all icons fit.
Expected result: Task width or number of icons changed.

Step: Verify that overflow indicator disappears when all icons fit.
End of test.
